biomarkers.name: CD20+, CD5- (usually), CD10-, DBA.44 (KLH-1)+
biomarkers.clinical_use: Diagnostic panel; villous lymphocytes in blood; sinusoidal BM infiltration

biomarkers.name: HCV serology
biomarkers.clinical_use: HCV eradication may induce lymphoma remission — antiviral therapy first-line if HCV+

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Biphasic architecture with small round cells at centre and larger cells at periphery of splenic white pulp nodules; villous lymphocytes in blood
variants: hairy cell leukaemia variant (HCL-v — distinct from SMZL though can overlap morphologically)

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: HCV association in some cohorts suggests antigen-driven biology
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Splenic white pulp nodule expansion with biphasic morphology; sinusoidal BM infiltration

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Splenic marginal zone B cells — memory B cells populating the splenic marginal zone (mantle zone-adjacent region around white pulp)
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Mesoderm — lymphoid (splenic marginal zone B cells)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Splenic marginal zone B cell differentiation with biphasic architecture (small round cells at centre and larger cells at periphery of splenic white pulp nodules); villous lymphocytes in blood
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Same marginal zone B-cell lineage as other MZL entities; NOTCH2 mutations, KLF2 mutations, del7q characteristic; HCV association suggests antigen-driven biology
